A '''blue-bladed lightsaber''' was [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|wielded]] by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Jang Li-Li]] prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="dr">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Li-Li [[Death/Legends|died]] when her [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was destroyed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]]-allied [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. Afterwards, Ventress scoured the debris and found Li-Li's severed [[Limb/Legends|hand]] still clutching her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber's]] charred handle. She presented the trophy to the [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of the Confederacy, [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku.
Despite being sad at her passing, Dooku modified her partially destroyed lightsaber by outfitting it with a holorecorder to deliver a private message to [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].<ref name="dr" />
